description: READ-ONLY: WHY this node's standing for an address is the number it is — the rating made auditable, provable per txHash. Returns directMicro/circleMicro/inboundMicro/totalMicro (matching lawbor_credit exactly) PLUS the evidence trail: `direct` = the raw settlement edges this node paid them (each with txHash + jobId), `circle` = the depth-2 grants with which SEED conferred each one, `inbound` = what they paid this node, and `bound` = the conservation ceiling total ≤ (1+alpha)·spend(viewer) that makes it unfarmable. A rating you can verify on Base yourself, not one you must trust. Input: of (0x address).
name: lawbor_why
